description: Structure a B2B positioning review, map buyer roles and alternatives, develop a value proposition and messages, and turn supplied positioning into channel drafts.

interface.longDescription: Helix GTM Consulting. Structure a B2B positioning review, map buyer roles and alternatives, develop a value proposition and messages, and turn supplied positioning into channel drafts. This package connects to 8 hosted rule based tools. The server does not run an AI model or perform live company research. It uses your supplied inputs; some outputs are working drafts or include explicitly labelled example assumptions. Review facts, calculations and placeholders before use. It does not connect to your CRM or send emails. Tool inputs are sent to the hosted service; consult its privacy policy for data handling.
defaultPrompt: Help me clarify positioning from my product and buyer brief.
Map the buyer roles involved in evaluating my product.
Draft positioning messages using my supplied evidence.

positive.prompt:
Use this synthetic review scenario, not a claim about any real company. Positioning method guide. Use these inputs:
{"focus_phase": "all", "your_sector": "saas"}
positive.expected_behavior: Explain all six IMPACT phases and their purpose without claiming to have researched a company.
